info.title: Staffing Hub API
info.description: Manage employees, their roles, technologies and skills, customers, and missions.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: The staffing situation at a glance.

tags.name: Skills
tags.description: Specific skills within a technology (e.g. Streams for Java).

tags.name: Employees
tags.description: Employees, their manager, roles, technologies and skill levels.

tags.name: Technologies
tags.description: Technologies (e.g. Java, React) and the skills grouped under each one.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Clients that employees can be staffed on.

tags.name: Missions
tags.description: Missions for customers, the skills they require, and the employees assigned to them.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: Job roles an employee can hold (e.g. Tech Lead, Developer).

get.summary: Get a technology by id, with its skills

delete.summary: Delete a skill (removes it from every employee)

get.summary: Get a mission with its required skills and assignments

delete.summary: Delete a mission (and its required skills and assignments)

put.summary: Require a skill for a mission, or change its required level (optional)

delete.summary: Remove a required skill from a mission

get.summary: Get one of a mission's assignments

delete.summary: Remove an assignment from a mission

put.summary: Replace an employee's details and manager

delete.summary: Delete an employee (their staff are kept, without a manager; refused if they have mission assignments)

put.summary: Set all of an employee's technologies (removes skills in dropped ones)
Add a skill to an employee, or change its level

delete.summary: Remove a skill from an employee

put.summary: Set all of an employee's roles

get.summary: List all technologies, with their skills
List all skills, optionally only those of one technology
List missions (paginated), optionally filtered by text, customer, status and business unit

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the label, project name or customer name, case-insensitive

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

post.summary: Assign an employee to a mission (allowed even if their skill levels fall short)

get.summary: Search employees (paginated); every filter is optional, former employees are hidden by default

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the first and/or last name, case-insensitive (e.g. "ada", "ada love")

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: Only employees with this role

parameters.name: technologyId
parameters.description: Only employees with this technology

parameters.name: skillId
parameters.description: Only employees with this skill

parameters.name: minSkillLevel
parameters.description: With skillId: only employees at this level or above

parameters.name: managerId
parameters.description: Only the direct staff of this manager

parameters.name: includeFormer
parameters.description: Include employees whose departure date has passed (default false)

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

get.summary: List an employee's mission assignments, most recent first
Find who is available over a period, most available first (paginated)
get.description: Accepts the same filters as the employee search. Availability is what the employee can take on for the whole period: 100% minus their peak occupation on any single day. Assignments without a start date are ignored, without an end date are ongoing, and without a rate count as 100%. An employee who leaves during the period has 0% availability.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Part of the first and/or last name, case-insensitive (e.g. "ada", "ada love")

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: Only employees with this role

parameters.name: technologyId
parameters.description: Only employees with this technology

parameters.name: skillId
parameters.description: Only employees with this skill

parameters.name: minSkillLevel
parameters.description: With skillId: only employees at this level or above

parameters.name: managerId
parameters.description: Only the direct staff of this manager

parameters.name: includeFormer
parameters.description: Include employees whose departure date has passed (default false)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First day of the period (included)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Last day of the period (included); leave empty for an open-ended period

parameters.name: minAvailability
parameters.description: Only employees with at least this availability (percent) over the whole period

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index (0..N)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.
